## Your use case / 使用场景
What do you want to accomplish? / 你希望完成什么任务？

## Feedback / 反馈
Which part of the preview or workflow is useful, unclear, or missing? / 哪部分展示或流程有用、难理解或缺失？

## Context / 背景（可选）
Your operating system, experience level, and the page you reviewed. / 系统、经验与查看的页面。

Please use public or synthetic examples. Remove credentials, personal data, account balances and private trading records before posting. / 请使用公开或合成示例，发布前移除密钥、个人信息、账户余额与私有交易记录。
